title: Fully redesign pi-goal around reducer and run-lease controller
description: Replace the monolithic lifecycle extension with a pure goal state reducer, branch-aware event store, serialized runtime controller, explicit progress checkpoints, and evidence-bound completion. Compatibility with the existing implementation is not required. Definition of done: all tasks complete, full tests pass, typecheck and diff checks pass, and README/skill/context describe the new model.

logs.msg: User explicitly removed compatibility constraint and requested a ground-up redesign. Current implementation is monolithic (~2500 lines) with implicit lifecycle ownership; target is reducer + event store + run-lease controller.

Independent review fixes applied: restart/tree/shutdown now end and pause persisted runs; execution deadlines abort at maxExecutionSeconds; reducer/store enforce evidence-gated completion; pending continuations carry revision and are cleared on activity/compaction invalidation; turn IDs retain bounded event-history coverage. Added regression tests. Verification: bun test 27 passed / 59 expectations, bunx tsc --noEmit, git diff --check.
